name: claude-skills
description: Custom Claude Code skills for productivity workflows

plugins.name: agent-teams
plugins.description: Multi-agent orchestration: spin up a read-only research team to explore a topic from multiple angles, or an implementation team that follows a phased PRAR workflow.

plugins.name: code-craft
plugins.description: Inner-loop coding helpers: skills to organize uncommitted changes into clean commits (git-commit) and rewrite messy branch history before a PR (rewrite-commits), plus subagents for codebase research, runtime verification, test running, commit organization, and scope guarding.

plugins.name: prose-guard
plugins.description: Quality control for written output: flag AI-slop in agent-generated text and suggest rewrites, and audit documents for unverified technical claims, verifying attributions against real sources (SIFT).

plugins.name: utils
plugins.description: Standalone utility skills: look at local images with a local vision model (OCR, describe, read diagrams) and prune stale ~/.claude/projects/ folders.

plugins.name: distill
plugins.description: Distill insights from browser bookmarks/history, Pocket/Raindrop exports, or URL lists into an Obsidian vault. Scales to 76K+ URLs via domain triage, curl-based scraping, and model routing (haiku for triage, sonnet for classification).

plugins.name: learn-x-in-y-minutes
plugins.description: Generate a learnxinyminutes.com-style tutorial for anything: a CLI command, language, library, framework, algorithm, concept, or GitHub repo.

plugins.name: agents-md-skill
plugins.description: Write lean, effective agent instructions — context files (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md) and slash commands. Most auto-generated ones make agents worse (arXiv:2602.11988v1). This skill knows what to keep and what to cut.
